value.rationale: The exact all-rank Euclidean intrinsic volume profile of a canonical graph-zonotope family is a naturally motivated invariant, not an arbitrary slice. The same geometrically dictated Gram weights yield an explicit fixed-k Dirichlet(3/2) forest fragmentation law and a different positive-density exponentially tilted gap law with logarithmic maximum. This clarifies a mathematical transition and provides sharp volume estimates beyond discrete graph face numbers and the general prior subdeterminant formula.
